title: Response to the comment concerning the article: Systemic organophosphate poisoning in child following anti-lice lotion application. Journal of Analytical Toxicology, bkaf096
content: We thank the author for their comment, which gives us the opportunity to clarify the neurological interpretation in our report. The point raised concerns the use of the expression “peripheral neuropathies” and the potential confusion with the delayed axonopathy classically referred to as organophosphate-induced delayed polyneuropathy.
siteTitle: Journal of Analytical Toxicology Current Issue
